questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which interface obtained its IPv4 address through DHCP?
questions.explanation: The Method column shows DHCP for Gi0/1 and manual configuration for Gi0/0.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0     192.0.2.1       YES manual up     up
GigabitEthernet0/1     198.51.100.18   YES DHCP   up     up

option_explanations.A: The Method column shows manual for Gi0/0.
option_explanations.B: The Method column shows DHCP for Gi0/1 and manual configuration for Gi0/0.
option_explanations.D: Only one row in the exhibit shows DHCP.

questions.question: Which command enables a routed port from interface configuration mode after a previous shutdown?
questions.explanation: no shutdown removes the administrative disable flag. Physical link still depends on the medium and peer.

option_explanations.A: Clearing counters resets statistics rather than enabling the port.
option_explanations.C: no shutdown removes the administrative disable flag. Physical link still depends on the medium and peer.
option_explanations.D: Removing the IP address does not remove an administrative shutdown.

questions.question: From IOS routed-interface configuration mode, which command assigns 192.0.2.129/25?
questions.explanation: IOS expects a dotted-decimal subnet mask. The address .128 is the network ID in this /25.

option_explanations.A: 0.0.0.127 is the wildcard (inverse) form, not the interface subnet mask.
option_explanations.B: IOS expects a dotted-decimal subnet mask. The address .128 is the network ID in this /25.
option_explanations.D: .128 is the network address of the /25, not the requested host address.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which action removes the explicit administrative barrier on Gi0/0?

options.A: Change the IPv4 subnet mask to /32

questions.explanation: Administratively down indicates the port was disabled through configuration.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0     192.0.2.129     YES manual administratively down down

option_explanations.A: Changing the mask does not enable an administratively disabled interface.
option_explanations.B: Clearing counters leaves the port configuration intact.
option_explanations.C: shutdown applies the barrier the question asks to remove.
option_explanations.D: Administratively down means the port is disabled by configuration. In interface mode, no shutdown removes that setting.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which check is most directly relevant to the displayed state?

options.B: Check cable seating and the peer port's link state
options.D: Change the static route's destination prefix

questions.explanation: Down/down without the administrative qualifier usually points to lack of link on this Ethernet port.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/1     192.0.2.1       YES manual down                  down

option_explanations.A: ARP entries do not determine whether the Ethernet port has carrier.
option_explanations.B: Down/down without the administrative qualifier usually points to lack of link on this Ethernet port.
option_explanations.C: DNS resolution is higher layer and cannot bring up the link.
option_explanations.D: Static-route configuration cannot create physical link on this interface.

questions.question: Refer to the illustrative serial-interface exhibit. Which conclusion follows from the first line?

options.B: The route to the far network has been installed
options.C: The interface status is up but its line protocol is down
options.D: Both status and protocol are up

questions.explanation: The two values are separate. The first reports interface status and the second reports line protocol.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Serial0/0/0 is up, line protocol is down

option_explanations.A: The first status is up rather than administratively down.
option_explanations.B: The line does not show any routing-table entry.
option_explanations.C: The two values are separate. The first reports interface status and the second reports line protocol.
option_explanations.D: The second value reports that line protocol is down.

questions.question: Which command shows physical error counters and duplex for GigabitEthernet0/1 on a typical IOS Ethernet interface?
questions.explanation: The detailed interface view includes operational settings and counters omitted by the brief address summary.

option_explanations.A: The detailed interface view includes operational settings and counters omitted by the brief address summary.
option_explanations.B: This filters the running configuration for hostname only.
option_explanations.C: The brief output shows the state columns but not detailed physical counters or duplex.
option_explanations.D: Connected route output lists network reachability rather than interface error details.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which conclusion about this routed interface is supported?

options.A: The DHCP server has leased the address 0.0.0.0
options.B: The port was shut down by configuration
options.C: The connected IPv4 route is available for the configured /24
options.D: The link and line protocol are up, but no IPv4 address is shown

questions.explanation: An Ethernet link can operate without a configured IPv4 address. Unassigned describes the address column.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/2     unassigned      YES unset  up                    up

option_explanations.A: Unassigned is not a DHCP lease for 0.0.0.0.
option_explanations.B: An administratively disabled interface would not be shown as up/up.
option_explanations.C: The address column is unassigned, so the row does not establish a connected /24.
option_explanations.D: An Ethernet link can operate without a configured IPv4 address. Unassigned describes the address column.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. A remote IPv4 application remains unreachable. Which statement is supported?

options.B: The remote server has confirmed the return route
options.C: The local router has a static route to every remote subnet
options.D: The local port is operational, so remote reachability requires further checks

questions.explanation: Up/up is local interface evidence. It does not establish end-to-end routing or application reachability.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
GigabitEthernet0/0 is up, line protocol is up

option_explanations.A: The port is up/up, not administratively down.
option_explanations.B: A local interface state does not demonstrate the remote endpoint's return route.
option_explanations.C: The exhibit does not show any static routes.
option_explanations.D: Up/up is local interface evidence. It does not establish end-to-end routing or application reachability.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which pair of actions distinguishes the two initial checks?

options.A: Replace both IPv4 masks before checking either port
options.B: Change both ports to DHCP before inspecting their state
options.C: Check Gi0/0's carrier path and Gi0/1's shutdown setting
options.D: Check Gi0/0's shutdown setting and Gi0/1's carrier path

questions.explanation: Plain down and administratively down distinguish operational link loss from a configured shutdown.
questions.snippet:
Illustrative excerpt
Interface              IP-Address      OK? Method Status                Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0     192.0.2.9       YES manual down                  down
GigabitEthernet0/1     198.51.100.1    YES manual administratively down down

option_explanations.A: Changing masks addresses IPv4 configuration and does not distinguish carrier loss from shutdown.
option_explanations.B: DHCP cannot repair either physical carrier or administrative shutdown.
option_explanations.C: Gi0/0 is plain down, so check its carrier path. Gi0/1 is administratively down, so check its shutdown setting.
option_explanations.D: The checks are reversed. Gi0/0 is plain down, while Gi0/1 is administratively down.
